evidence: Commit dca3bb6673 notes: 'Before this change only per-peer stats were gathered. They are lost when the peer disconnects.'
Implements issue #26337 ('Add per message stats to getnettotals rpc') and continues work from earlier PRs #27534 and #28926.
result.scope_notes: The PR description presents examples of passing arguments to getnetmsgstats to filter or group dimensions, but the patch itself takes no parameters and returns the complete nested hierarchy.
result.card: Adds global network message statistics collection to CConnman and exposes it through a new getnetmsgstats RPC. Currently, per-message traffic metrics exist only per peer on active connections and are lost upon disconnection, preventing operators from seeing cumulative bandwidth consumption by message type and network over the node lifetime. This resolves longstanding feature request #26337 and follows up on previous closed PRs #27534 and #28926. Unlike previous iterations, it records atomic counts across multidimensional static arrays to allow lock-free updates on the P2P hot path.
